implementation_goal: Implement all Level 1: MVP features defined in the PRP - Stages 1-5 of the project workflow (Intake, Get Clarifications, Triage, Review with Specialist Leads), plus the cross-cutting Knowledge Upload and Project Brain Chatbot features.
relevant_files_context: Greenfield project - repo (github.com/paulworrall/Project_Brain) exists but is empty
Accounts already provisioned: GitHub, Anthropic Console (API key in .env.local, not committed), Vercel (team: MAP), Neon Postgres (project: Project_Brain, Postgres 18)

figma_context.notes: No design assets provided - UI is built from scratch following the 'clean, efficient, professional, genuinely well-designed' direction in the PRP

notes_assumptions: This is a real internal pilot, not a stakeholder demo - prioritize correctness and data integrity of agent outputs over visual polish, though the PRP explicitly calls for a strong UX to drive adoption
Desktop-first (~90% of usage), but must remain usable on mobile/tablet (~10%)
Real client data must NEVER be used - only anonymized seed data (Hub 'Caroline', Clients 'Fizzy', 'Coffee', 'Tooth') until IT/security sign-off, per PRP system rules
Every AI agent must return structured output (defined JSON shape), not free text the app has to parse
Client-facing artifacts (emails, documents) are always drafts for human review - never auto-sent
The chatbot's cross-project isolation is a hard requirement - every query must filter by project_id at the database layer
